source_basis.note: FIFA's global talent-development study analysed 205 member associations and identifies these as key areas of the talent-development ecosystem.
FIFA's Talent Academy/TDS strategy uses academy standards, deployed talent coaches, local coaching capacity and structured talent-development pathways.
UEFA's Coaching Convention provides a standard coach-education framework and recognised licence pathway across member associations.

talent_identification.description: Evidence that talent is systematically identified/scouted rather than relying only on incidental club discovery.

training_environment.description: Evidence of structured high-performance training environments, technical centres or equivalent sustained training provision.

playing_opportunities.description: Evidence that youth talent receives structured age-appropriate competitive playing opportunities.

youth_to_senior_transition.description: Evidence about the pathway and transition from youth development into senior/professional football.

coaching_capacity.description: Evidence about qualified coach depth, coach education, coach educators or comparable technical-human-capital capacity.

academy_pathway_coverage.description: Evidence of academy/pathway structures and their coverage, standards or accreditation rather than merely one academy existing.

organised_competition_roots.description: Dated roots of organised national or territory-wide competition.

club_roots.description: Dated early club-football roots where directly sourced.

continuity_discontinuity_context.description: Evidence of governance/competition breaks or transitions that prevents treating age as uninterrupted continuity.

cultural_audience_embedding.description: Independent evidence of long-run cultural salience, audience/fan embedding or comparable societal football importance.

safeguards: Facet coverage is evidence coverage, not a quality score.
No facet count may be converted mechanically into a 1-10 rating.
A single academy, centre or programme does not establish nationwide quality or coverage.
Held-out validation countries must remain excluded from model fitting.
Missing facet evidence is unknown, not negative evidence.
Development calibration must not be attempted from structural timeline age alone.
Tradition calibration requires cultural/continuity context beyond historical age.
